evals.name: series-day-7
evals.prompt: channel 'Daily DSA' day 7 of 30: two pointer technique, example: find a pair with target sum in a sorted array. tomorrow: sliding window
evals.expected_output: A series post with a consistent header (Day 7/30), the technique explained with the example, a reaction-style CTA (not 'comment below'), and a 'Tomorrow: sliding window' footer.
assertions: Explains two pointers with the sorted-array pair example
CTA uses reactions/forwarding, not replies or comments

checks.why: the message comes first, no preamble

checks.pattern: comment below|reply below|comment your|drop a comment

checks.why: no Markdown that WhatsApp shows literally
